llm_router.note: Bring your own key. The site host never sees or pays for inference; keys stay in the visitor's browser and are sent only to the selected router.

networks.description: Verifies a claim against recent news coverage: finds relevant sources, cross-checks them, and writes a sourced verdict with a confidence score.
networks.name: evidence_desk
sample_queries: A major earthquake struck Indonesia this week.
A central bank raised interest rates this week.
Scientists announced a breakthrough in fusion energy.
A new COVID variant is spreading rapidly.

peer_policy.note: Peer calls require the visitor's approval on a consent card before each contact with a third-party origin.
